service.description: The header badge counts of a user over what the framework holds, for the theme value STRT_SHELL_COUNTS_SERVICE when BasicComms is the Comms app (BasicCommsSetupData.xml; an app suite replaces it with its own, as IronStone BOSS does with mantle.party.PartyServices.get#ShellCounts, which adds today, notifications and internal messages). counts: email (org.moqui.mail.EmailClientServices.count#UnreadEmail), chat (org.moqui.chat.ChatServices.get#UnreadCounts total) and calls (org.moqui.call.CallServices.count#MissedCalls). Each part stands alone: one that fails is logged by name, null in counts and named in failedParts. Another user's counts only with authorization already disabled (internal work: publish#ShellCounts).

Comms Home for the current user, over the user's mail and chat. cardList: the counters, each {key, title, value, icon, link}: one per mail account with its unread Inbox mail, Flagged, Snoozed (back by the end of today), Mentions (chat), Not sent (sends that failed) and Missed calls (not seen yet), and Voicemail (unheard; only for a user with a voicemail box). roomList: the chat rooms with unread, ten at most. needsReplyList, followUpList, meetingList and mailboxList are an app's (its inbox-source answers this operation) and empty here. hasMailAccount is false until the user has a mail account; problemAccountList names the accounts whose sign-in or sync failed, with canManage (only a manager fixes one). failedParts names what could not be read.
